data.summary:
Respected and self‐motivated professional with more than 11 years of experience from which 8 years in Trade Capture – Fund accounting & more than 3.5 years’ experience in core fund accounting team. Worked in transitioning and successful migration of new funds and on multiple structures.
To obtain a position in the field of finance with a special interest in investment banking and financial services that will utilize my skills, experience and education.

raw_sections.summary:
Professional Summary
Respected and self‐motivated professional with more than 11 years of experience from which 8 years in Trade Capture – Fund accounting & more than 3.5 years’ experience in core fund accounting team. Worked in transitioning and successful migration of new funds and on multiple structures.
Career Objective
To obtain a position in the field of finance with a special interest in investment banking and financial services that will utilize my skills, experience and education.
raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Associate, Fund/Client Accounting II - (Bank of New York, Pune, India)
April 2022 to January 2026
➢ Perform daily, weekly, and monthly NAV
➢ Compare NAV calculated by fund administrators with internal records and resolve
variances.
➢ Perform daily cash & position reconciliation between Asset Managers/Funds and
Custodians/Prime Brokers & investigate breaks and discrepancies in pricing and
accruals as well.
➢ Daily monitoring and review of activities like trades, capital stock, income, expense,
various derivative products, corporate actions & pre/post pricing activities
➢ Liaise with fund administrators, custodians, and internal teams to resolve reconciliation
issues. Ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
➢ Prepare and maintain reconciliation reports and documentation for audit purposes.
➢ Support process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency.
➢ Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities related to NAV.
➢ Lead, manage and guide team members to ensure SLA and quality adherence
➢ Identify process improvement opportunities and drive execution
➢ Once pricing applied by pricing team on securities, check securities with missing price
and escalate to get it done.
➢ Executed wire transfers, distributions, capital calls, and IPO Trades, booking the
movement as well as other activity during daily cash reconciliations.
➢ Provided training to multiple partners & Initiated knowledge share activity in the team
to build better understanding among the partners, took part in organizing team building
activities.
Intermediate Representative (FA - Trade Capture) - (Bank of New York, Pune, India)
Dec 2014 to April 2022
➢ Performing the trade processing activity as per the client or IA instruction which
includes fixed income, equity, currency, money market, future & options for mutual funds on Invest one application.
➢ Managing daily SLA with accuracy & timely manner. Reconciliation of accounting
records to custody, broker, and counterparty records of mutual funds.
➢ Escalation to the IA as per. Co- ordinate with different departments like corporate
action, reconciliation, Security data management & fund accounting team for resolving any break.
➢ Maintaining the daily activity and perform the documentation part on daily basis.  Conducting training session on fund and trade, money market and derivatives to the new joiner also to the onshore team & participating in BCP activity.
➢ Resolving the issue while trade processing and increase the productivity.
➢ Maintaining & updating SOP’s required for daily business activity ➢ Worked with SWIFT settlement instructions to support timely and accurate trade
settlements across global markets.
➢ Performed trade validation by verifying ISIN, quantity, price, settlement date, currency,
counterparty, and settlement instructions before trade posting.
raw_sections.skills:
Technical Skills
➢ Competent in Bloomberg, IDC, DTCC, Xceptor, Invest One & Eagle application ➢ Proficient at MS Office applications ➢ TLM (Reconciliation) & Nexen (Custody) ➢ ➢ Swift
JIRA & ECRM.
raw_sections.education:
Education
MBA (FINANCE) AISSMS, Pune 2013
B.Sc. Hotel Management IHTM , Pune 2009
